$description: DreamShip OS component layer: only decisions a component needs that a semantic role does not already state.

gradient-caption.$description: Text never sits directly on a brand gradient (no single colour reaches 4.5:1 across tide). A caption over a gradient gets this solid backing.

control.$description: Fields and buttons (xvzo6.9). Name in the base, value in the theme (ARCH 2026-11-10).

height-touch.$description: Control height under a coarse pointer (touch).

height.$description: Choice chip height: the 40 px pointer target (feedback #16).

label.$description: Status badge text keeps the kit v1.0 look: the editorial label style (operator ruling 2026-11-11 06:00Z, dreamship-v0-xvzo6.10). Colour stays the status role, so light success text is 5.05:1, not the kit's deep jade (3.84:1).
